project.description: Daily export of LogHub logs: check the delivered file, check its size, write log-level counts.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: INPUT_FILE
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Delivered file to export (empty: the standard delivery for SOURCE)

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: MIN_ROWS
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Smallest delivery that counts as complete

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: #!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail case "$SOURCE" in spark) standard=/data/loghub/Spark_2k.log ;; hdfs) standard=/data/loghub/HDFS_2k.log ;; *) echo "ERROR: unknown SOURCE '$SOURCE' (expected spark or hdfs)"; exit 2 ;; esac input="${INPUT_FILE:-$standard}" echo "[export] source=$SOURCE input=$input min_rows=$MIN_ROWS" if [ ! -f "$input" ]; then echo "ERROR: input file not found: $input (No such file or directory)" echo "[export] files in $(dirname "$input"):" ls -1 "$(dirname "$input")" 2>&1 | head -20 || true exit 2 fi rows=$(wc -l < "$input" | tr -d ' ') echo "[export] read $rows rows" if [ "$rows" -lt "$MIN_ROWS" ]; then echo "ERROR: DATA_QUALITY_FAILED: min_row_count expected >= $MIN_ROWS, got $rows" exit 3 fi mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" out="$OUTPUT_DIR/${SOURCE}_levels.tsv" for level in INFO WARN ERROR FATAL; do printf '%s\t%s\n' "$level" "$(grep -c " $level " "$input" || true)" done > "$out" echo "[export] wrote $out" cat "$out"
